Hi {!Contact.FirstName},
Following up on our earlier notice: your goodr wholesale account is set to be deactivated on {!Shopify_At_Risk_Notice__c.Deactivation_Date__c} due to inactivity. As of today, no order has been placed.
If you’d like to keep your account active, please place an order before the deactivation date. We’re happy to help if you have any questions.
Best,
The goodr wholesale team
